data_transform: race-wide scalar; log(p_full/market) gauge cancels on normalization; no refit
descriptives: period/date scores, leave-one-date-out, best/worst five race contributions, support bins [0,1/3),[1/3,2/3),[2/3,1]; no posthoc rule changes
population: exact pinned 331 development races / 2360 runners; 177 evaluation races /1251 runners; existing reservation/incident gate before decoding
rule: runner q = min(prior_start_count,5)/5 * mean(min(context_count,3)/3 for venue,distance,grade; unavailable context rate or count -> support0) * (1 - missing_base16_fraction); race S = arithmetic mean(q); alpha = S/(S+lambda); prediction proportional to market * (saved_full/market)**alpha
selection: minimum earlier pooled OOF race log loss; exact tie prefer lambda1 (stronger shrinkage); existing OUTER inner splits; no outer feedback
stopping: exactly two lambda evaluations per outer fold; no feature/parameter expansion after evaluation; negative result completed

uncertainty.family: adaptive vs market/full/half x LL/Brier (6 contrasts); paired pointwise and simultaneous max-standardized intervals; exploratory only
